$comment: Platform preference (card x5wnfcg). redMainHold on|off: while main's CI is red the drain contains it (tool override env WE_DRAIN_RED_MAIN_HOLD). redMainMode stop|quarantine: stop = only the main-fix PR(s) land, others held red-main-hold; quarantine = known failing tests skipped via ops/quarantine and other PRs keep landing (tool override env WE_DRAIN_RED_MAIN_MODE). See scripts/lib/red-main-hold.mjs and scripts/lib/red-main-quarantine.mjs. redMainQuarantine cascade: unitJobPattern matches vitest jobs (default test-shard, integration, soak-shard); derivedJobs are aggregators (test, daemon-soak, coverage-merge). maxTests caps live files plus additions (5); ttlMin is expiry minutes (1440, at most 24h). requireProvenFlake (boolean, true; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_REQUIRE_PROVEN_FLAKE on|off) requires a green rerun of the failing commit or enabled repeat-failure proof (a green merge group is never proof: it tested its queued PR's changes). fileCardPerEntry (boolean, true; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_FILE_CARD_PER_ENTRY on|off) records one owed repair card per entry. Each key resolves standard → platform → this redMainQuarantine block → WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_* env; TTL_MIN, MAX_TESTS, UNIT_JOB_PATTERN, DERIVED_JOBS override the corresponding keys. R157: repeatFailureProof (boolean, default true; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_REPEAT_FAILURE_PROOF on|off) permits the same file failing in repeatFailureCount distinct main runs (positive integer, default 2; WE_RED_MAIN_QUARANTINE_REPEAT_FAILURE_COUNT), with no test-file changes between their head SHAs. repeat-failed is a deterministic-failure quarantine, not flake evidence: unchanged tests can expose real source regressions, including failures on the same SHA. Repair remains owed before the 24h expiry; main always runs these tests. Unknown diffs fail closed. Evidence reads are bounded to 10 runs; larger counts hold for operator repair.
